name: claude-skills
description: A growing collection of Claude Code skills, built and field-tested on real workflows before being generalized and shared.

plugins.name: secure-file-organizer
plugins.description: Organizes a messy filesystem into a clean category structure while detecting sensitive personal documents by content (not just filename) and routing them into a macOS encrypted vault.

plugins.name: travel-itinerary-builder
plugins.description: Plans and verifies a multi-day trip, then generates a phone-first live trip guide (HTML with an illustrated real-coastline route map, Now/Next, day plans, options, vetted food and bars), a shareable A4 PDF with working links, and PNG pages for WhatsApp.
